title: Highly recommended experience
text: Great experience with chef Rudy.  Great food and wine.   The food is excellent and beautifully presented.  The small group  makes it very personal.
author: John_C

title: Great local experience.  Top notch!
text: Rudi was super friendly and knowledgeable.   We had a fantastic time talking with him and enjoying is beautiful and tasty courses.   The wine pairing was also great.   Highly recommended experience.
author: John_C

title: Amazing food & wine!!
text: Must do! Incredible chef Rudi creates the most delicious & beautiful courses. Private dining setting, no crowds. The wine & food were plentiful. Rudi & his assistant were just lovely. Highly recommend this experience!
author: Daniel_B

title: Beautiful evening
text:
A beautiful evening with very nice table guests.
Excellent 9 course menu that leaves nothing to be desired.
We would like to thank the very nice and competent host Rudi.
 Highly recommended, come back next year.
author: Climber56092530993

title: Foodie dream dinner
text: An absolutely unique and fantastic experience. Rudi is a fantastic chef and warm and welcoming host. His menu is unique, absolutely delicious, and his plating and presentation are truly a work of art. One of the most memorable dining experiences we’ve ever had. A truly wonderful way to spend our last night in Barcelona.
author: Suzanne  H

title: Private dining authentic Venezuelan food of the highest standard for the family
text: What an amazing experience, we all enjoyed as a family. Rudi, is an incredible chef and his dishes are truley a taste of Venezuela. Such a  treat with a private dining experience, a must have for a visit to Barcelona. His presentation of dishes and attention to detail are exquisite. Definitely the highlight of our weekend break.
author: Rinkyrinx

title: A feast for the senses!
text: It was a wonderfully beautiful and unforgettable evening. Our host Rudi was very attentive and accommodating and of course he can cook incredibly well. The food was a feast for the eyes and palate. If you are looking for something special, you are in the right place. We will definitely come back!
author: jacquelinekW6992SM

title: What a night!
text:
We joined the table with another 8-10 people from the UK and the US. We were all in awe of Rudi's beautifully crafted dishes that were as delicious as they were original. The meal was accompanied by excellent wine pairings, each dish and wine explained by the chef. By the end of the night we felt like we got way more than our money's worth, both in food and new friends.
This was easily one of the best meals we've had in Barcelona.
author: 888oferc

title: Top top top
text:
Eating at Rudi is a culinary taste experience! At first a bit suspicious because you are sitting with “strangers” at one table but a super nice group and has become very cozy. Rudi actually deserves a star in terms of cooking and refinement, so much passion for cooking and all his dishes. 
The concept is unique and a very nice experience.
author: Peggytje

title: Different, delicious and so much fun!
text:
I went to this experience when I was solo in Barcelona. I was not sure what to expect, but it was surely intriguing to try something that is not yet another restaurant.
Well, I was right to give it a shot. This was by far the best evening in Barcelona. The host Rudi as so nice and professional, the other guests were such interesting people and the wine poured like water. The food was so original and refreshing, so beautiful and tasty, and Rudi was there to explain to us the dishes and give us this added value I was looking for. Absolutely a must!
author: Daya2908
